notes.text: The Eruvin passage explicitly gives Yusti son of Rabbi Simon in Boethus’s name in a discussion of residence rights.
The Shekalim passage supplies the name form Yusta son of Rabbi Simon on substitution of lost shekels. It gives a separate statement without the Boethus attribution.
